scientific_role: Secondary pre-graph-WB method-development variant of M2 using an interpretable local closeness criterion.

closeness_definition.statement: A candidate is locally close enough when its RMSE is no more than 15 percent above the corresponding M1 reference RMSE.
closeness_definition.search_reference: same frozen M1 best local-search MSE reference used by primary Phase-5 M2
closeness_definition.confirmation_reference: same frozen M1 selected N=100 confirmation MSE reference used by primary Phase-5 M2

reuse_exactly: existing frozen M1 TPE warm-start candidates
existing frozen Phase-5 M2 48-point LHS candidates
existing frozen Phase-5 M2 48 GP level-set acquisitions

portfolio_construction.selection_rule: same primary M2 rule: lowest local MSE first, then greedy maximin distance in normalized parameter coordinates with deterministic tie breaks
portfolio_construction.final_selection: first three confirmation-compatible candidates in frozen provisional order

failure_semantics: If fewer than five search-compatible candidates exist under RMSE15, or fewer than three of the frozen five-member provisional portfolio pass RMSE15 confirmation, mark the secondary variant NOT_INSTANTIABLE for that provider. Do not alter the 15 percent RMSE rule after graph outcomes.
next_gate: Run the read-only RMSE15 compatibility audit on all existing candidate observations before any new confirmation simulation.
